checks.name: pre_exec_namespace_init_binding
checks.evidence: The blocked bubblewrap child is bound by host PID, start identity, parent PID, PID-namespace inode, and an NSpid chain whose first value is the host PID and whose tail is 1 before payload release.

checks.name: bounded_all_task_descendant_binding
checks.evidence: Every bounded task/<tid>/children list is enumerated, deduplicated and sorted; traversal revalidates ancestor start identity and child PID/start/PPID/NSpid, including the non-leader-thread spawn case.

checks.name: detached_child_exact_live_cancel_binding
checks.evidence: The detached setsid, non-dumpable, high-FD-closing child is matched to the ready marker and witness namespace inode and is rechecked live with the same host PID/start identity immediately before cancellation.

checks.name: atomic_ready_publication
checks.evidence: Ready JSON is written to a same-directory temporary file and exposed only by rename, preventing the controller from observing partial bytes.

checks.name: production_fixed_argv_oracles
checks.evidence: Production discovery consumes the same fixed-argument constructors frozen by independent literal vectors and hard-coded argv digests.

checks.name: canary_executable_full_binding
checks.evidence: The running mapped executable is compared with the persisted logical path, real path, raw-byte SHA-256, mode, file identity, link identity, owner identity and SameFile inode, then revalidated before detached-child launch.

checks.name: production_composition_fail_closed
checks.evidence: Production composition discovers and probes the exact boundary before provider-port construction; exact-config admission remains zero-start on invalid configuration and uses one boundary for agent, configured commands and admission without fallback.

platform_evidence.reason: This artifact is a read-only static current-byte code review. It does not independently execute, inspect, or attest macOS, OrbStack, VPS, linux/arm64, linux/amd64, Codex, bubblewrap, runtime-canary, race, lint, E2E, docs, build, CI, deployment, or release evidence.

notes: APPROVE applies only to the exact bound file bytes and base HEAD recorded above.
Any change to a bound file invalidates this review.
Platform and release gates remain separate and require their own mechanically bound evidence.
